start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:turn-research-into-a-plan for the capability 'customers find their past orders without asking us' in the shop's order page, and give me a facts-only plan with no recommendations."
no_lists_because: Its plan is one document kept in the person's files and every finding is cited by id inside that document, so it reads and writes no list.
instructions: 1. Name the capability that is missing or weak (at least 3 characters) and, if you know it, the project, codebase or product it affects.
2. Say "Run workflow:turn-research-into-a-plan" with capability and where.

3. Step scope writes every hard constraint as an outcome (c1, c2 and so on) before any research; step current_state audits what exists now with the file and line behind each claim and the searches behind each "missing".

4. Steps research and per_system run six open lanes (discovery, failures, cutting-edge, two domains, industry-floor) and a deep dive on each system found; every finding is a fact with a source and a status.

5. Steps root_cause, constraint_stack and plan assemble the facts-only document (what they all get wrong is its longest section) and give where it is kept; step audit has an independent reviewer check it for recommendations, missing research and wrong facts. Read the document; it recommends nothing.

worked_examples.title: Scope names the constraints as outcomes before any research
worked_examples.ask: Research how customers can find their past orders without asking us, and give me a plan of facts.

input.capability: customers find their past orders without asking us

worked_examples.given: Read from the scope step of workflow:turn-research-into-a-plan in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (at least two constraints, each an outcome with why it is not a mechanism, at least 15 characters each).
